source_metadata_review: NOAA catalog and3200 hourly OPeNDAP form actually read;3200 daily DAS fetched and reviewed2026-11-02. Daily unfilled UCUR/VCUR and their uncertainty fields are distinct from *_FILLED variables. No paper figure pixels or digitization claimed.
source_attribution: Sloyan, Cowley and Chapman, CSIRO/IMOS EAC individual mooring daily-depth gridded product, NOAA OceanSITES mirror; Scientific Data11,10(2024), doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02857-x; CC BY4.0.
time_operator: Select the unique source daily timestamp whose UTC calendar date equals the prescribed model date. Retain actual timestamp. The daily product uses a5-day filter and daily interpolation; it is not the model instantaneous00Z field. No averaging or clock shifting by OSW.
source_support: Processed observations, linearly gridded vertically and temporally; use unfilled fields only, not SOM-filled velocities or spatially mapped no-slip boundaries. The shallowest velocity observations are approximately20m; source0m coordinate does not guarantee surface flow support.
component_operator: Poleward meridional component=-VCUR, positive south. This matches the nominal pilot27S downstream direction180degrees but is not full speed, slope rotation, or measured cross-section-normal transport.
layer_operator: Reuse frozen connected-layer operator at each prescribed fixed mooring, without peak-based mooring substitution. Keep unknown upper/lower boundaries, native brackets and source uncertainty arrays. No zero fill, seabed substitute or extrapolation.
comparison_role: Record nearest existing27S model sample node and geodesic separation for spatial audit only. No acceptance distance chosen from results, model interpolation, observed/model residual, current-axis validation or whole-route inheritance.
uncertainty_policy: Retain source component standard_error arrays. They do not establish a universal sigma, independent errors or propagated depth confidence interval.
processing_policy: Sequential bounded OPeNDAP subsets and tests on one idle cloud CPU. Read coordinates first and check per-station and cumulative field budgets before velocity reads. No full original download, no local ocean-field processing or tests. Decoded profiles retained; no wire-byte or complete-source hash claim.
